name: Matiur Rahman
contribution: He attempted to defect with a Pakistani aircraft to join the liberation cause and died when the aircraft crashed.
context: Attempted escape flight from Pakistan, August 1971.
impact: He became a lasting symbol of patriotic defiance from within the Pakistan Air Force.
highlight: He risked everything to bring military assets to the liberation side.
